# ScribeCat 0.25.5

## Fixed
- Keep PDF pinch zoom centered on the moving pinch midpoint.
- Add a minimize button for PDF split view.
- Route local Office/video links to the in-app viewer.
- Add PowerPoint single-slide/all-slides viewing and insertion choices.
- Improve Word preview text contrast.
- Hide task/journal files from split selection.

## Docker
- Publish `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.5`.
- Set the Server Edition Compose default to `0.25.5`.
